title: Officeworks Gift Cards and Returned Item
body:
Has anyone had experience with this:
If I pay for a purchase in the store and use multiple gift cards, and then I return that purchase, how do I get my money back?
I called them up and they were useless so I need to go into the store tomorrow, but wondering if anyone's done this.
OW AI chat says I'd get a single gift card back — is that right?
Reason is I bought those discounted cards recently but I've just realised that I can't use multiple gift cards online, which I need to do because the thing I want to buy is "online only". And apparently I can't pay for "online only" items in store.
So my genius idea is to use up the gift cards in store, then return it immediately to get a single gift card that I can use on the online store.
